description: Add an item to cart. Requires vendor id + menu item id from search_product (products[]) or view_vendor_items. Always pass item type menu.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

step_37_body_address_id.description: From get_addresses after user confirms pretty_name — never ask user to type this.

step_47_body_vendor_id.description: Vendor id: search_product data[].id OR view_vendor_items vendor. Not the menu item id.

step_57_body_data_0_products_0_name.description: Display name of the menu item from search/menu response.

step_61_body_items_0_discount_price.description: Discount price in kobo; same as price_per_quantity if no discount.

step_61_body_items_0_item_id.description: Menu item id: search_product data[].products[].id OR view_vendor_items menu item id.

step_61_body_items_0_pack_reference.description: Pack reference if required; else empty string.

step_61_body_items_0_price_per_quantity.description: Unit price in kobo from menu/search response.

step_7_body_data_0_cart_items_0_type.description: Always menu for food items (never container). Omit to use default menu.

name: add_item_to_cart
